name: Witch Hill
summary: Mirefin murlocs camp around Witch Hill, where Swamplight Manor stands near the path to Theramore. Rumors of hauntings trouble the lonely rise.

sections.title: A Blighted Rise
sections.body: Witch Hill rises from the waters of Dustwallow Marsh, about a third of the way down the peninsula toward Theramore Isle. Mirefin murlocs claim the waters around it, and their camps make the swamp dangerous. Near the hill's center stands Swamplight Manor, home to the hermit known as 'Swamp Eye' Jarl. Travelers report eerie sights and dark presences across the rise.

sections.title: The Haunting of the Hill
sections.body: Rumors of hauntings cling to Witch Hill's desolate ground. Mirefin murlocs are not the only danger there. Occult threats trouble the hill, and even Theramore patrols find it unsettling.

faq.answer: Witch Hill lies in Dustwallow Marsh, about a third of the way down the peninsula that runs from the western marsh toward Theramore Isle.
'Swamp Eye' Jarl lives in Swamplight Manor near the hill's center. Mirefin murlocs camp in the surrounding lowlands.

faq.q: Why is the area called Witch Hill?
faq.answer: Witch Hill has a sinister reputation for dark magic, odd lights, and supernatural danger. Swamplight Manor's eerie solitude adds to its name.

faq.q: What threats should travelers look out for on Witch Hill?
faq.answer: Watch for Mirefin murlocs camping around Witch Hill, and heed the rumors of hauntings on the rise.

angles.text: As a warlock, you may sense the rumors of hauntings clinging to Witch Hill as you travel the road toward Theramore.
Witch Hill borders the main overland route toward Theramore Isle, where murloc tribes and dark entities trouble travelers and couriers.
